sentences.text:
13 November, 2019
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.V.S.S.Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.6581 of 2019
Order:

1. This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner / Accused No.2 under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioner, in FIR No.159 of 2018, on the file of the Station House Officer, Tekkali Police Station, Srikakulam District.

The alleged offences against the petitioner are under sections 188, 270, 272, 273 of IPC and Sections 58, 59, 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Section 20(2) Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard Sri R.Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent / State.
Both of them agree that the issue in this case is squarely covered by the earlier orders passed by this Court.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in a similar case, this Court, by virtue of common order in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein by considering that transportation of Gutka is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 of IPC and FSS Act.
A perusal of the Order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

4. Hence, following the said order and in terms thereof, the Criminal Petition is allowed in part and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.159 of 2018, on the file of the Station House DVSS,J Officer, Tekkali Police Station, Srikakulam District for the offences under sections 188, 270,
272, 273 of IPC and Sections 58, 59, 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006

are hereby quashed,
except Section 20(2) Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003, which shall continue.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal petition shall stand closed.

SRI D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU,J Date: 13.11.2019 rpd.
